plan.threshold_selection: validation only, max recall at <=2% empirical FPR; F1 then Brier tie breaks
plan.calibration: sigmoid fitted on validation; threshold and model selection reuse that partition
plan.holdout_policy: All stages and model selections locked before any holdout scoring.
plan.missing_data: Retain every candidate, represent missing observations with availability flags.
limitations: Small prospective convenience pilot, not independent population-level ground truth.
Official reference identity does not prove absence of compromise or financial misconduct.
Public threat feeds may share reports despite different direct label and feature sources.
A single collection session cannot establish long-term temporal or campaign robustness.
At this sample size, 2% empirical validation FPR is not a statistical safety guarantee.
Calibration, threshold and model selection reuse validation; estimates can be optimistic.
Phishing/reference scope does not establish deceptive-store or investment detection accuracy.

clock_normalization.amendment: After acquisition integrity checks and before model scoring; model/threshold/split policy unchanged.
clock_normalization.semantics: first_seen_at retains actual host completion; only derived assessment asOf advances to a reported source clock. No capture or attack dates are reconstructed.

collection_diagnostics: Host public-DNS failures were observed near collection completion; worker-specific failure causes were not retained, so not every missing observation can be attributed to DNS. Every failed observation remains missing, not a negative safety finding.

source_provenance.purpose: Aligned current phishing/reference pilot; research-only, no production promotion.
source_provenance.selection: 100 recent community-verified online source URLs; one public registrable domain each; label-independent URL hash. All 100 prespecified official reference URLs retained.
source_provenance.observation_protocol: Static isolated HTML and authoritative DNS/RDAP, plus current Google/OpenPhish; actual per-request dates and assessment time preserved. No historical replay.

labels.positive: Published community verified and online feed status; not independently re-adjudicated by this project.
labels.negative: Curated official-site reference class for a contemporaneous pilot; identity references, not a financial audit or guarantee of compromise-free pages.

source_provenance.collection_order: Label-independent deterministic SHA256 order; one URL at a time, at most two isolated worker requests.
limits: Small convenience cohort; reference identity is not an independent compromise/security audit.
Public feeds may share reports; source independence does not establish statistical independence.
Registered domains control overlap but unknown cross-domain campaigns can overlap.
Short one-session collection cannot establish long-term temporal robustness.
Do not discard samples because content, DNS, RDAP or provider checks fail.

sampling_bias: Negatives are famous HTTPS homepages; positives retain arbitrary feed paths. URL/path/length, institution age, popularity and acquisition-source shortcuts may dominate. No matched benign-path or independently adjudicated current business cohort is claimed.
